purpose: Exact low multiplication and dedicated low-square composition backed by accepted recursive full kernels.
domain: Positive full-u64 equal-length inputs, top1..64; full threshold>=56, low_limit>=24, all pre-existing split modes0/1/2 retained. No normalized-input precondition.
mul_space: 12n caller-owned scratch, reusing product2k+full child12k and truncated cross-product h+12h lifetimes. Actual module focused proof passed; immutable whole gate pending.
square_space: 10n caller-owned scratch, full square2k+10k and one low product h+12h lifetimes. Actual module focused proof passed; immutable whole gate pending.
square_mechanism: One truncated cross product contributes twice; specialized low square leaves from9 limbs are retained.
analytic_cost: Low multiply<=full(k)+2low(h)+O(n); low square<=full_square(k)+low_product(h)+O(n), using the actual selected split. Analytic only.
modular_semantics: Output equals a*b or a*a modulo2^(64*(n-1)+top).
